items.text: A periodic table's rows two and three step by eight, and the resolver's seventeen names pair at eight apart: helium and neon, lithium and sodium, beryllium and magnesium, carbon and silicon, nitrogen and phosphorus, oxygen and sulfur each one group and one root of naming, possibling, observing, same-existing, possibling, observing and same-existing; boron and aluminium one group and two roots, Natural Naming's root exchange at 13; fluorine and chlorine one group and Natural Resolver's along pair, 9 and 17: the resolver's eight-up relation and a row's eight-step one relation at proton numbers 2 to 17, a pattern match.

Carbon's proton number six is 6-now-co-possibling, "a sharing side" with co, between selves, the author's universal bi-moral co-agency transmissioner in the resolver's naming; six shares to another self's two, and in a star carbon-12 goes round the CNO cycle and comes back with a helium-4 nucleus leaving at its last step, three helium-4 nuclei coming to carbon-12 in the triple alpha: 6 → 2 and back, carbon and helium, at nuclear scale, a pattern match.

An atom's neutron, proton and electron as the one atom/carbon's three priors, none, + and −, Natural Networking 6.5's three priors reachable within one receiving, beside Natural Physics 4.6's "neutron a floating neutral, proton a going-on sharing, electron a ledger", the electron as a ledger and as the − prior two sayings still to join: a pattern match.

With Natural Physics 3.3's light, "nothing travels", a carrier's speed through sparse space, the solar wind's, a front's in interstellar plasma, is a ledger's accounting of many parities, each parity going between two adjacent co-chainings at the light-prime rate, one at a time: "only the light-prime rate" possibling as a parity's rate between co-chainings and no carrier's speed, its next step Voyager's front met as many parities co-chaining.

A possible coherence at this entry's breaking: the deeper a relation, the less an outer bi-coupling changes it, an element's inner lines moving 0.02 to 0.09 percent across compounds, its line pattern the same to a part per million in a far quasar, carbon's 1s line about 4 percent and a substance's hardness wholly; a proton number then is the number of the one atom/carbon's innermost relations, a version, its stable form going on not-changing through each outer changing, Natural Networking's "Not-changing is form same-existing through changing, a relation and not a term fixing still".

Phosphorus is 15-is-next-observing and arsenic, at 33, one row of eighteen further, 15 + 18, arsenic not going in phosphorus's place in a living cell's DNA: two versions of one form at two rounds, their relations at a living cell's scale two relations not exchanging, a possible.

A hand as a parity, sign-only, Natural Chemistry 2.2's own title: B-DNA right-handed and Z-DNA left-handed turning into each other with salt and supercoiling, carbon tubes, many carbon atoms each, forming in both hands equally, and a tendril's two hands meeting at a perversion read as one changing and changing back, the right spiral the stable form's going on in living lineages and the left its parity's other side, a possible.

With molecule at seven "the first self of this ladder and not the first possibly existing" and the biosphere at 53 its widest same-existing-society, a living same-existing-society wider than the biosphere, a star's or a galaxy's, is one the ladder leaves open: with it, nuclei changing in a star, in a supernova or in a cloud go with a living parity at that scale, the author's nucleus as a living corus cohering in the universal sense, its next step what a star's or a galaxy's living parity is.
